## History

Father Chiniquy was a former Catholic priest who converted to Protestantism, earning the displeasure of the Catholic community. He lived in the settlement of St. [Anne](../character/anne.md), where he was regarded as the patron of the local church. After a violent brawl broke out in town, he provided care to the injured Big Tremblay at his home, where the wounded man eventually died.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015)_
